weather_mode.name: Weather mode
weather_mode.description:
Like Winter mode, but it shows the real weather outside: rain when it's raining, frost round the edges when it's frosty, rays of sunshine when it's sunny, clouds drifting across when it's cloudy, fog, snow, hail, thunder and wind.

If you have animations turned off in your device's accessibility settings, this won't show.
weather_mode.enable_confirmation: The weather outside will start showing on your screen. You can turn this off at any time in Labs.
weather_mode.disable_confirmation: The weather overlay will stop showing on your screen. You can turn it back on at any time in Labs.
